subject: general
question: Pola festival is associated with which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Maharashtra.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Pola Festival

 
 
• Pola Festival is a thanksgiving festival celebrated by farmers in Maharashtra and Chhattisgarh, to acknowledge the importance of bulls and oxen, who are a crucial part of agriculture and farming activities.
 
• It falls on the day of the Pithori Amavasya in the month of Shraavana.
 
• The farmers decorate their bulls on this day and then worship them to perform in the festival.
 
• This festival is celebrated to show their gratitude towards the bulls for their assistance in the agricultural works by the farmers.
 
• On the following day of the festival, the plowing activities are started and seeds are sown in the fields.
 
• It is a very unique festival in Maharashtra where an animal is made the focus of the occasion.
 
• During the Sravana month, the Pola festival is celebrated on a new moon day which is also called the Pithori Amavasya day.
 
• The farmers celebrate this day with many traditional dishes like kunbis, poli and karanji which are authentic Maharashtra dishes.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Mizoram:-**

 
 
• It is known for its **Chapchar Kut festival**, which is celebrated in March after the completion of the Jhum cultivation.
 
 
 
• **Nagaland:-**
 
 
• **​**It celebrates the** Hornbill festival** in December to showcase the state's tribal culture and traditions.
 
 
 
• ** Karnataka:-**
 
 
• **​**It is famous for its **Mysuru Dasara festival,** which is a 10-day-long celebration of the victory of good over evil.
